bio.topic: Review: coordination, homeostasis, drugs and reproduction

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which part of a neurone carries impulses away from the cell body?
questions.hint: Think of the long fibre leading towards the next neurone.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the gap between two neurones.
questions.hint: Neurotransmitters diffuse across it.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What is the correct order of a reflex arc?
options: receptor → sensory neurone → relay neurone → motor neurone → effector
effector → motor neurone → relay neurone → sensory neurone → receptor
receptor → motor neurone → relay neurone → sensory neurone → effector
sensory neurone → receptor → effector → motor neurone → relay neurone
questions.answer: receptor → sensory neurone → relay neurone → motor neurone → effector
questions.hint: Start where the stimulus is detected.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which gland secretes insulin?
questions.hint: It also produces digestive enzymes.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Compared with nervous control, hormonal control is usually…
questions.hint: Hormones travel in the blood.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the hormone released by the adrenal glands in a 'fight or flight' situation.
questions.hint: It increases heart rate.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: When blood glucose concentration falls, the pancreas releases glucagon. What does glucagon cause the liver to do?
questions.hint: The aim is to raise blood glucose.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which of these happens in the skin when body temperature rises above normal?
options: vasodilation of arterioles near the surface
questions.answer: vasodilation of arterioles near the surface
questions.hint: More blood near the surface loses more heat.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What term describes the maintenance of a constant internal environment?
questions.hint: It includes control of temperature and blood glucose.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Negative feedback means that a change from the set point…
options: triggers a response that reverses the change
triggers a response that increases the change
has no effect on the body
questions.answer: triggers a response that reverses the change
questions.hint: Think of a thermostat.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which type of drug is penicillin?
questions.hint: It kills bacteria but not viruses.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain why antibiotics should not be used to treat viral infections such as the common cold.
questions.hint: Consider what antibiotics target and the risk of resistance.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Where does fertilisation normally take place in humans?
questions.hint: It is also called the Fallopian tube.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which hormone, produced mainly by the ovaries, causes the lining of the uterus to thicken after menstruation?
questions.hint: It is also responsible for female secondary sexual characteristics.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: In a 28-day menstrual cycle, menstruation lasts from day 1 to day 5 and ovulation happens on day 14. How many days after the last day of menstruation does ovulation occur?
questions.hint: Subtract the last day of bleeding from the ovulation day.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Describe two roles of the placenta in supporting a developing fetus.
questions.hint: Think about substances that pass in each direction.

bss.topic: Revisão do 1º term: Brasil colonial, cartografia e geologia

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual era o principal produto de exportação do Brasil colonial nos séculos XVI e XVII?
questions.hint: Pense nos engenhos do Nordeste.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual árvore deu nome ao Brasil e foi o primeiro produto explorado pelos portugueses?
questions.hint: Dela se extraía uma tinta vermelha.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual sistema administrativo dividiu o território em grandes faixas de terra entregues a donatários, a partir de 1534?
questions.hint: Eram passadas de pai para filho.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual cidade foi a primeira capital do Brasil colonial?
questions.hint: Fica na Bahia.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: No século XVIII, a descoberta de ouro deslocou o centro econômico da colônia para qual região?
questions.hint: O nome da região já dá a pista.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que era o 'pacto colonial'?
options: a obrigação de a colônia comerciar apenas com a metrópole
um acordo de paz com povos indígenas
a divisão do território entre Portugal e Espanha
a lei que aboliu a escravidão
questions.answer: a obrigação de a colônia comerciar apenas com a metrópole
questions.hint: Pense em quem controlava o comércio.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique por que os quilombos são considerados uma forma de resistência à escravidão no Brasil colonial.
questions.hint: Pense em quem vivia neles e no que significavam.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em um mapa na escala 1:100.000, quanto representa 1 cm?
questions.hint: 100.000 cm = ? metros.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em um mapa de escala 1:250.000, duas cidades estão a 8 cm uma da outra. Qual é a distância real, em quilômetros?
questions.hint: Multiplique e converta centímetros para quilômetros.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual mapa tem MAIOR escala (mostra mais detalhes)?
questions.hint: Quanto menor o denominador, maior a escala.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: As linhas imaginárias que medem a distância em graus a partir da Linha do Equador são os…
questions.hint: Elas correm de leste a oeste.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama a representação do relevo por linhas que ligam pontos de mesma altitude?
questions.hint: Aparecem em mapas topográficos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é a forma de relevo predominante no território brasileiro?
options: depressões abaixo do nível do mar
questions.hint: O Brasil não tem cordilheiras como os Andes.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que o Brasil praticamente não tem vulcões ativos nem grandes terremotos?
options: porque está no centro da placa Sul-Americana
questions.answer: porque está no centro da placa Sul-Americana
questions.hint: Pense em onde ficam os limites das placas tectônicas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual tipo de rocha se forma pelo acúmulo e compactação de sedimentos?
questions.hint: O nome vem de 'sedimento'.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique a diferença entre agentes internos e agentes externos na formação do relevo, dando um exemplo de cada.
questions.hint: Uns vêm do interior da Terra; outros atuam na superfície.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which method of production makes one unique product at a time, such as a wedding dress?
questions.hint: Each order is a separate 'job'.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is an advantage of flow production?
options: work is very varied for employees
questions.hint: Think of economies of scale.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What term describes a production approach where materials arrive exactly when they are needed, so little stock is held?
questions.hint: Its initials are three letters.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Quality assurance differs from quality control because it…
options: checks quality at every stage of production
removes the need for any standards
questions.answer: checks quality at every stage of production
questions.hint: Think about prevention rather than detection.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which of these is a fixed cost for a café?
questions.hint: It does not change with the number of drinks sold.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business has fixed costs of $12,000. Each unit sells for $20 and has a variable cost of $8. Calculate the break-even output in units.
questions.hint: Divide fixed costs by contribution per unit.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Using the same business (price $20, variable cost $8, fixed costs $12,000), calculate the profit if 1,500 units are sold, in dollars.
questions.hint: Total revenue minus total costs.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What is the margin of safety?
options: the amount by which sales exceed the break-even level
the cash held in the bank
questions.answer: the amount by which sales exceed the break-even level
questions.hint: Compare actual output with break-even output.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business starts the month with an opening cash balance of $3,000. Cash inflows are $7,500 and cash outflows are $9,200. Calculate the closing cash balance in dollars.
questions.hint: Opening balance + inflows − outflows.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is a way to improve cash flow in the short term?
options: ask customers to pay more quickly
questions.answer: ask customers to pay more quickly
questions.hint: Get money in sooner or pay it out later.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which financial statement shows revenue, costs and profit over a period of time?
questions.hint: It used to be called the profit and loss account.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Revenue is $50,000 and cost of sales is $30,000. Calculate the gross profit in dollars.
questions.hint: Gross profit = revenue − cost of sales.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Gross profit is $20,000 and revenue is $50,000. Calculate the gross profit margin as a percentage.
questions.hint: (Gross profit ÷ revenue) × 100.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A statement of financial position shows a business's…
options: assets and liabilities at one point in time
questions.answer: assets and liabilities at one point in time
questions.hint: It is like a snapshot.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Explain why a profitable business might still run out of cash.
questions.hint: Consider the timing of payments from customers and to suppliers.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A bakery is considering replacing batch production with flow production. Discuss one advantage and one disadvantage of this change.
questions.hint: Think about costs, flexibility and product variety.

chem.topic: Review: metals, chemistry of the environment, fuels, alkanes and alkenes

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which metal is extracted from its ore by electrolysis rather than by reduction with carbon?
questions.hint: It is more reactive than carbon.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Name the main iron ore used in the blast furnace.
questions.hint: Its formula is Fe₂O₃.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: In the blast furnace, which substance acts as the main reducing agent for iron(III) oxide?
questions.hint: It is formed from coke and carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: What is the purpose of adding limestone to the blast furnace?
options: to remove silicon dioxide impurities as slag
questions.answer: to remove silicon dioxide impurities as slag
questions.hint: Calcium oxide reacts with acidic impurities.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Why is aluminium resistant to corrosion even though it is a reactive metal?
options: it has a protective oxide layer
it is below hydrogen in the reactivity series
it does not react with oxygen
it is always alloyed with gold
questions.answer: it has a protective oxide layer
questions.hint: Think about what forms on its surface.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which pollutant is produced by incomplete combustion of fuels and is toxic because it reduces the blood's ability to carry oxygen?
questions.hint: It binds to haemoglobin.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which gas is the main cause of acid rain from burning fossil fuels containing sulfur?
questions.hint: Its name tells you which element it contains.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: What does a catalytic converter change carbon monoxide into?
questions.hint: It adds oxygen to the CO.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Fractional distillation separates crude oil because the fractions have different…
questions.hint: The column is hotter at the bottom.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: What is the general formula of the alkanes?
questions.hint: Ethane has 2 carbon atoms and 6 hydrogen atoms.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: How many hydrogen atoms are in one molecule of propane?
questions.hint: Use the alkane general formula with n = 3.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which reagent can distinguish an alkene from an alkane?
questions.hint: One of them decolourises it.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Alkanes react with chlorine in the presence of ultraviolet light. What type of reaction is this?
questions.hint: A hydrogen atom is swapped for a chlorine atom.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Name the product formed when ethene reacts with steam in the presence of a catalyst.
questions.hint: It is an alcohol with two carbon atoms.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Why are alkenes described as unsaturated?
options: they contain a C=C double bond
questions.answer: they contain a C=C double bond
questions.hint: Think about what allows addition reactions.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Explain why cracking is used in the petrochemical industry.
questions.hint: Compare the supply of long-chain fractions with the demand for shorter ones.

comp.topic: Term 1 review: internet, cyber security, emerging technologies and programming

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which protocol is used to transfer web pages securely between a browser and a web server?
questions.hint: Look for the version of the web protocol that adds encryption.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What does URL stand for?
questions.hint: It is the full text address typed into a browser to find a resource.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the main role of a DNS server?
options: It translates a domain name into an IP address
It stores all the web pages on the internet
It encrypts data sent over a network
It assigns MAC addresses to devices
questions.answer: It translates a domain name into an IP address
questions.hint: Computers locate each other using numbers, but people type names.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which threat uses a fake email to trick a user into revealing personal details?
questions.hint: The attack 'fishes' for information through a message.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which threat uses malicious code to redirect a user to a fake website even when they type the correct URL?
questions.hint: The user does nothing wrong — the redirection happens on their computer or DNS.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What name is given to the software or hardware that monitors traffic into and out of a network and blocks traffic that does not meet set rules?
questions.hint: Think of a barrier between a trusted network and the internet.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which of these is a biometric method of authentication?
questions.hint: Biometrics use a physical characteristic of the person.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which description best fits a DDoS attack?
options: Many computers flood a server with requests so it cannot respond
A user is tricked into giving away a password
Software records every key a user presses
Data is intercepted while being transmitted
questions.answer: Many computers flood a server with requests so it cannot respond
questions.hint: 'Distributed' and 'denial of service' are the key ideas.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What term describes a type of AI in which a program improves its performance by learning from data, changing its own rules?
questions.hint: The computer is said to 'learn' — what type of learning?

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which part of an expert system applies the rules to the facts in the knowledge base to reach a conclusion?
questions.hint: This part 'infers' or reasons.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: An array Scores is declared with indexes 1 to 20. How many elements can it store?
questions.hint: Count from the lowest index to the highest index inclusive.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: A 1D array Nums holds the values 4, 7, 2, 9, 5 in positions 1 to 5. What is Nums[2] + Nums[4]?
questions.hint: Position 1 holds 4; count along carefully.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Trace this pseudocode: Total ← 0; FOR i ← 1 TO 4: Total ← Total + i * 2; NEXT i; OUTPUT Total. What is output?
questions.hint: Write down the value of Total after each pass of the loop.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the key difference between a function and a procedure?
options: A function returns a value; a procedure does not have to
A procedure returns a value; a function never does
A procedure can only be called once
questions.answer: A function returns a value; a procedure does not have to
questions.hint: Think about what each one gives back to the calling code.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Explain why a programmer might use local variables rather than global variables inside a subroutine.
questions.hint: Think about scope, memory and avoiding accidental changes elsewhere in the program.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Describe how SSL/TLS helps keep data secure when it is sent between a browser and a web server.
questions.hint: Mention certificates, authentication and encryption.

econ.topic: Term 1 review: economic development and international trade

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Which indicator combines life expectancy, education and income per head?
questions.hint: It measures more than just money.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Specialising in the good a country can produce at the lowest opportunity cost reflects which type of advantage?
questions.hint: It is not 'absolute' — it compares opportunity costs.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: What is a tariff?
options: A limit on the quantity of imports
questions.hint: It raises the price of foreign goods.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: What is an import quota?
options: A limit on the quantity of a good that can be imported
An agreement to remove trade barriers
questions.answer: A limit on the quantity of a good that can be imported
questions.hint: Think about quantity rather than price.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: If a country's currency depreciates, what is likely to happen to the price of its exports in foreign currencies?
questions.hint: Foreigners need less of their own currency to buy the same amount of this currency.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Which item is recorded in the current account of the balance of payments?
options: Foreign direct investment in a new factory
questions.hint: The current account covers trade in goods and services, income and transfers.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: When the value of imports of goods and services is greater than the value of exports, the country has a…
questions.hint: More money is flowing out for trade than is coming in.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: A country exports goods and services worth $450bn and imports goods and services worth $520bn. What is its balance of trade in $bn?
questions.hint: Balance = exports − imports; watch the sign.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: The exchange rate changes from £1 = $1.20 to £1 = $1.50. A US-made product costs $30. By how many pounds does its price in pounds fall?
questions.hint: Work out the price in pounds at each exchange rate first.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Which is a common characteristic of many developing economies?
options: A large share of employment in the primary sector
A high proportion of people over 65
Most workers in the quaternary sector
questions.answer: A large share of employment in the primary sector
questions.hint: Think about farming, fishing and mining.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Which is an argument used to support protectionism?
questions.hint: New firms may need time to grow before facing competition.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Which is most likely to result from free trade for consumers?
questions.hint: Think about more competition from abroad.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: What name is given to a firm that has operations in more than one country?
questions.hint: Think 'many nations'.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: In a floating exchange rate system, the exchange rate is determined by…
options: demand for and supply of the currency
the government setting a fixed value
questions.answer: demand for and supply of the currency
questions.hint: Think of a market price.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Explain one reason why a fall in a country's exchange rate might not improve its current account balance.
questions.hint: Consider price elasticity of demand for exports and imports, or quality and time lags.

questions.subject: econ
questions.q: Discuss whether a government should use tariffs to protect domestic jobs.
questions.hint: Give arguments on both sides — consider retaliation, consumers and inefficient firms — and reach a judgement.

en.topic: Term 1 review: Paper 1 questions and directed writing

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which language device is used in 'The wind howled angrily around the house'?
questions.hint: Can the wind really feel angry?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Identify the device in 'Her voice was velvet.'
questions.hint: There is no 'like' or 'as'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In 'He crept towards the door, his heart hammering', which word best suggests he is trying not to be heard?
questions.hint: Which verb describes a quiet, careful way of moving?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In a directed writing task, what does 'audience' mean?
options: The people the text is written for
The text type, such as a letter
questions.answer: The people the text is written for
questions.hint: Ask yourself: who will read this?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which register best suits a letter to a head teacher proposing a change to the school day?
questions.hint: Think about the relationship between writer and reader.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In a summary task, what should you avoid?
options: Copying long phrases and adding your own opinions
questions.answer: Copying long phrases and adding your own opinions
questions.hint: A summary should be concise and based only on the text.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What term describes repeating the same consonant sound at the start of nearby words, as in 'bright blue balloons bobbed'?
questions.hint: Listen to the first letters of the words.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence contains a rhetorical question?
options: Isn't it time we protected our parks?
questions.answer: Isn't it time we protected our parks?
questions.hint: The writer does not expect a real answer.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In directed writing, what is the best way to use material from the reading passages?
options: Select and develop relevant ideas in your own words
Ignore the passages and invent new ideas
List every detail in the order given
questions.answer: Select and develop relevant ideas in your own words
questions.hint: Examiners reward evaluation and development, not copying.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which command word asks you to comment on how a writer's word choices create effects?
questions.hint: Which word requires the most detailed thinking?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the purpose of a topic sentence?
options: To introduce the main idea of a paragraph
questions.answer: To introduce the main idea of a paragraph
questions.hint: It usually comes first in the paragraph.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which connective introduces a contrasting idea?
questions.hint: Look for the word that signals 'on the other hand'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the term for deliberate exaggeration for effect, as in 'I've told you a million times'?
questions.hint: Has the speaker really said it a million times?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In 'The market was a riot of colour', what effect does the word 'riot' mainly create?
options: A sense of lively, chaotic energy
A sense of calm and order
questions.answer: A sense of lively, chaotic energy
questions.hint: Think about the connotations of a riot.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Explain the effect of the phrase 'the city slept beneath a blanket of fog'.
questions.hint: Consider both the personification of the city and the connotations of 'blanket'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write the opening two sentences of a formal letter to your local council arguing for more green spaces in your area.
questions.hint: Use a formal greeting and state your purpose clearly.

en_lit.topic: Term 1 review: poetry and The Tempest

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: In The Tempest, who is Prospero's daughter?
questions.hint: She has grown up on the island with her father.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Which spirit serves Prospero throughout The Tempest and longs for freedom?
questions.hint: Prospero freed this spirit from a tree.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: In The Tempest, who is the son of the witch Sycorax?
questions.hint: He claims the island was his first.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Who took Prospero's place as Duke of Milan?
questions.hint: It was a member of Prospero's own family.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Who falls in love with Miranda?
questions.hint: He is the son of the King of Naples.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Where does most of The Tempest take place?
options: In a royal court in Naples
questions.hint: The ship is wrecked near this place.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Alonso, whose ship is caught in the storm, is the King of which city?
questions.hint: His son Ferdinand is the prince of this Italian city.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: What does Prospero promise to do with his book of magic near the end of the play?
questions.hint: He also says he will bury his staff.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Which two comic characters plot with Caliban against Prospero?
questions.hint: One is a butler and the other a jester.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: What name is given to a 14-line poem, often written in iambic pentameter?
questions.hint: Count the lines — this form is famous for love poetry.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: What is enjambment?
options: A sentence running on past the end of a line without punctuation
A pause in the middle of a line
A repeated line at the end of each stanza
questions.answer: A sentence running on past the end of a line without punctuation
questions.hint: Think of the sense 'striding over' the line break.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: What is a caesura?
options: A pause within a line of poetry
A rhyme at the end of two lines
The last line of a poem
questions.answer: A pause within a line of poetry
questions.hint: It is often marked by punctuation mid-line.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: What is unrhymed iambic pentameter, used for much of the verse in The Tempest, called?
questions.hint: It has rhythm but no rhyme.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: In a passage-based question, what should your answer mainly focus on?
options: Close analysis of language in the extract, linked to the wider play
questions.answer: Close analysis of language in the extract, linked to the wider play
questions.hint: Stay close to the printed passage.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: How does the play present Caliban as both a villain and a victim? Support your answer with reference to the play.
questions.hint: Consider his plot against Prospero and the way he has been treated and how he speaks about the island.

questions.subject: en_lit
questions.q: Explore how a poet's use of one striking image can shape the mood of a poem. Refer to a poem you have studied.
questions.hint: Name the image, explain its connotations and link it to the overall mood.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Given y = 3x⁴, find the value of dy/dx when x = 1.
questions.hint: Multiply by the power, then reduce the power by one.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Find dy/dx for y = 5x³ − 2x + 7.
questions.hint: Differentiate term by term; a constant differentiates to zero.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Find the gradient of the curve y = x² − 6x + 1 at the point where x = 4.
questions.hint: Differentiate, then substitute.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Find the x-coordinate of the stationary point of y = x² − 8x + 3.
questions.hint: At a stationary point dy/dx = 0.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: y = x³ − 3x has stationary points at x = 1 and x = −1. What is the nature of the point at x = 1?
questions.hint: Find the sign of d²y/dx² at x = 1.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Write down the exact value of sin 60°.
questions.hint: Use an equilateral triangle of side 2 cut in half.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Write down the exact value of tan 45°.
questions.hint: Think of an isosceles right-angled triangle.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Which identity is always true?
options: tan x = cos x / sin x
questions.hint: It comes from Pythagoras' theorem on the unit circle.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Simplify (1 − cos²θ) / sin θ.
questions.hint: Replace the numerator using a Pythagorean identity.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Solve sin x = 0.5 for 0° ≤ x ≤ 180°. Give the larger solution, in degrees.
questions.hint: The sine curve is symmetrical about 90°.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Solve tan x = √3 for 0° ≤ x < 360°.
questions.hint: The tangent function repeats every 180°.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Given y = 4/x, find dy/dx when x = 2.
questions.hint: Write 4/x as 4x⁻¹ first.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Find dy/dx for y = √x.
questions.hint: Write √x as a power of x.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: The curve y = 2x³ − 3x² − 12x has two stationary points. Find the x-coordinate of the maximum point.
questions.hint: Factorise dy/dx, then test each point with the second derivative.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: What is the period, in degrees, of y = sin 2x?
questions.hint: The 2 makes the graph repeat more quickly than y = sin x.

questions.subject: fmath
questions.q: Show that (sin θ + cos θ)² ≡ 1 + 2 sin θ cos θ.
questions.hint: Expand the bracket and use an identity.

fre.topic: Review: education, work and the international world

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Choose the correct French for 'I would like to work abroad.'
questions.hint: 'Would like' needs the conditional, followed by an infinitive.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Give the French word for a school subject, such as maths or history.
questions.hint: It is a feminine noun.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which is the future tense of 'je vais' (aller)?
questions.hint: Aller has an irregular future stem.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Give the 'nous' form of avoir in the future tense.
questions.hint: The future stem of avoir is irregular: aur-.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete: 'Si j'avais de l'argent, je ___ en France.'
questions.hint: After si + imperfect, use the conditional.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: What is the French for 'unemployment'?
questions.hint: It is a masculine noun often heard in the news.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: What does 'un stage' mean in the context of work?
questions.hint: Students often do one before choosing a career.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which word means 'the environment'?
questions.hint: It looks very similar to the English word.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write 'faire' in the future tense for 'je'.
questions.hint: The future stem of faire is fer-.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: 'Je serais médecin' is in which tense?
questions.hint: Look at the ending -ais on an irregular stem.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: In France, 'le lycée' is…
options: a secondary school for students aged about 15 to 18
questions.answer: a secondary school for students aged about 15 to 18
questions.hint: Students take the baccalauréat there.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which phrase means 'a gap year'?
questions.hint: Think of a year away from studies.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete: 'Quand je ___ grand, je serai ingénieur.'
questions.hint: In French, 'quand' about the future takes the future tense.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: What is the French for 'a job interview'?
questions.hint: The word for 'hiring' follows 'entretien'.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write 2–3 sentences in French about the job you would like to do in the future and why. Use the conditional.
questions.hint: Start with 'Je voudrais être…' or 'J'aimerais…' and give a reason with 'parce que'.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write 2–3 sentences in French about an international event you will attend in the future. Use the future tense.
questions.hint: Use verbs such as 'j'irai', 'je verrai' and 'ce sera'.

geog.topic: Review: populations, towns and cities, development and employment

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: A population pyramid with a wide base and a narrow top suggests…
options: a high birth rate and low life expectancy
a low birth rate and high life expectancy
questions.answer: a high birth rate and low life expectancy
questions.hint: Look at how many young people there are compared with old.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What term describes the increase in the proportion of a population living in towns and cities?
questions.hint: It comes from the Latin word for city.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: A country has a birth rate of 30 per 1,000 and a death rate of 10 per 1,000. What is the natural increase per 1,000?
questions.hint: Subtract one rate from the other.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which is a push factor for rural–urban migration?
options: Crop failure and lack of jobs in the countryside
questions.answer: Crop failure and lack of jobs in the countryside
questions.hint: Push factors are reasons to leave a place.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is an informal (squatter) settlement?
options: Homes built on land residents do not own, often lacking services
questions.answer: Homes built on land residents do not own, often lacking services
questions.hint: Think about legality and access to water and electricity.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What term describes the movement of people from cities to surrounding rural areas and small towns?
questions.hint: It is the opposite of a process that brings people into cities.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: The dependency ratio compares…
options: dependants (young and elderly) with people of working age
questions.answer: dependants (young and elderly) with people of working age
questions.hint: Who relies on whom economically?

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which employment sector includes manufacturing?
questions.hint: It turns raw materials into products.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: As a country develops, the share of employment usually…
options: shifts from the primary sector to the secondary and tertiary sectors
shifts from the tertiary sector to the primary sector
stays the same in every sector
moves entirely into the quaternary sector
questions.answer: shifts from the primary sector to the secondary and tertiary sectors
questions.hint: Think about fewer people farming over time.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which is a feature of an ageing population?
options: A high proportion of people aged over 65
A wide base on the population pyramid
questions.answer: A high proportion of people aged over 65
questions.hint: Look at the top of the pyramid.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which employment sector involves research and development and information technology?
questions.hint: It comes after the tertiary sector.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which indicator measures the number of babies who die before their first birthday per 1,000 live births?
questions.hint: The word 'infant' is a clue.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is urban sprawl?
options: The unplanned spread of a city into the surrounding countryside
The rebuilding of old city centres
The growth of tall buildings in the CBD
questions.answer: The unplanned spread of a city into the surrounding countryside
questions.hint: Picture a city spreading outwards.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which is a likely problem of rapid urban growth in a lower-income country?
options: Shortages of clean water and sanitation
questions.answer: Shortages of clean water and sanitation
questions.hint: Services often cannot keep up with fast growth.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Explain two strategies a government might use to manage an ageing population.
questions.hint: Consider pensions, retirement age, immigration and healthcare.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: For a city you have studied, describe one strategy used to improve living conditions in informal settlements and assess how successful it has been.
questions.hint: Name the strategy, give specific evidence and judge strengths and weaknesses.

hist.topic: Review: origins of the Cold War, containment and Soviet control to 1968

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which US policy aimed to stop the spread of communism to new countries?
questions.hint: Think of 'keeping something in'.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What phrase, used in a 1946 speech, described the dividing line between communist Eastern Europe and the West?
questions.hint: It suggests a heavy, unbreakable barrier.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year did the Soviet blockade of West Berlin begin?
questions.hint: It was three years after the end of the Second World War.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: How did the Western Allies respond to the Berlin Blockade?
options: They supplied West Berlin by airlift
questions.answer: They supplied West Berlin by airlift
questions.hint: Roads and railways were blocked, so another route was used.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What military alliance did the USA and Western European countries form in 1949?
questions.hint: It is named after an ocean.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What alliance did the USSR and its satellite states form in 1955?
questions.hint: It is named after the capital of Poland.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year was the Hungarian Uprising crushed by Soviet forces?
questions.hint: It happened in the mid-1950s, the same year as the Suez Crisis.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year did the Cuban Missile Crisis take place?
questions.hint: It came one year after the Berlin Wall was built.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What did the USSR publicly agree to do to end the Cuban Missile Crisis?
questions.hint: The crisis was about weapons on the island.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What did the USA secretly agree to in return?
questions.hint: These missiles were close to the USSR's border.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year was the Berlin Wall built?
questions.hint: It went up in the early 1960s, before the Cuban Missile Crisis.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which 1968 event saw Warsaw Pact troops invade to end reforms?
questions.hint: The name refers to a season and a capital city.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which theory claimed that if one country fell to communism, its neighbours would follow?
questions.hint: Picture a row of falling game pieces.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: At which February 1945 conference did the 'Big Three' Allied leaders discuss post-war Europe?
questions.hint: It was held in Crimea before the war in Europe ended.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Explain why the USA became involved in Vietnam.
questions.hint: Link your answer to containment, the domino theory and events in South-East Asia.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: 'The main reason for the Cold War was the Soviet takeover of Eastern Europe.' How far do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.hint: Weigh this against other causes such as ideology, mistrust and the atomic bomb, then reach a judgement.

math.topic: Term 1 review: algebra, functions, calculus, trigonometry and vectors

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Solve 3x − 7 = 11.
questions.hint: Add 7 to both sides first.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Factorise x² − 5x + 6.
questions.hint: Find two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to −5.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: f(x) = 2x + 5. Find f(3).
questions.hint: Replace x with 3.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: f(x) = 3x − 1. Find f⁻¹(x).
questions.hint: Write y = 3x − 1 and rearrange to make x the subject.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: f(x) = x² and g(x) = x + 4. Find fg(1).
questions.hint: Work out g(1) first, then apply f.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: y = x³ + 2x. Find dy/dx when x = 2.
questions.hint: Differentiate each term, then substitute.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse 10 cm and one other side 6 cm. Find the length of the third side, in cm.
questions.hint: Use Pythagoras' theorem and subtract.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: In a right-angled triangle, the side opposite angle x is 5 cm and the hypotenuse is 10 cm. Find x in degrees.
questions.hint: Use SOH: sin x = opposite ÷ hypotenuse.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: In triangle ABC, a = 7, b = 8 and angle C = 60°. Use the cosine rule to find c².
questions.hint: c² = a² + b² − 2ab cos C, and cos 60° = 0.5.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: a = (3, −2) and b = (1, 4) are column vectors. Find 2a − b.
questions.hint: Double each component of a, then subtract b component by component.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Find the magnitude of the vector (6, 8).
questions.hint: Use Pythagoras on the two components.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Solve the simultaneous equations x + y = 10 and x − y = 4. What is x?
questions.hint: Add the two equations to eliminate y.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which is the correct expansion of (x + 3)²?
questions.hint: Write it as (x + 3)(x + 3) and multiply every term.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Find the gradient of the line through (1, 2) and (4, 11).
questions.hint: Gradient = change in y ÷ change in x.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Solve 2^x = 32.
questions.hint: Keep doubling from 2 and count.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A student writes √(9 + 16) = 3 + 4 = 7. Explain the mistake and give the correct value.
questions.hint: Can you take the square root of each part of a sum separately?

phys.topic: Review: electrical quantities, circuits and electromagnetism

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: A resistor of 6 Ω has a current of 2 A through it. What is the potential difference across it, in V?
questions.hint: Use V = I × R.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: A 4 Ω resistor and a 6 Ω resistor are connected in series. What is the total resistance, in Ω?
questions.hint: In series, resistances simply combine one way.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: Two 6 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is their combined resistance, in Ω?
questions.hint: Use 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: An appliance draws 5 A from a 230 V supply. What is its power, in W?
questions.hint: Use P = I × V.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: A current of 3 A flows for 20 s. How much charge flows, in C?
questions.hint: Use Q = I × t.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: In a series circuit, the current is…
questions.hint: There is only one path for the charge.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: In a parallel circuit, the potential difference across each branch is…
options: equal to the supply potential difference
questions.answer: equal to the supply potential difference
questions.hint: Each branch connects directly across the supply.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: What happens to the resistance of an NTC thermistor as its temperature rises?
questions.hint: These are used in circuits that respond to heat.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: What is the purpose of a fuse in a plug?
options: To melt and break the circuit if the current is too large
questions.answer: To melt and break the circuit if the current is too large
questions.hint: Think about protection from overheating and fire.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: In a UK three-pin plug, which wire is connected to the fuse?
questions.hint: It is the brown wire.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: Which change would increase the e.m.f. induced when a magnet moves into a coil?
questions.hint: The induced e.m.f. depends on the rate of change of magnetic field.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: A current-carrying wire in a magnetic field feels a force. What happens if the current is reversed?
questions.hint: Think about the interaction between the two magnetic fields.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: A transformer has 200 turns on the primary coil and 50 turns on the secondary coil. The input is 240 V. What is the output voltage, in V?
questions.hint: Vs/Vp = Ns/Np.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: Why is electricity transmitted through the National Grid at very high voltage?
options: To reduce the current and so reduce energy lost as heat
To increase the current in the cables
To make the electricity travel faster
questions.answer: To reduce the current and so reduce energy lost as heat
questions.hint: Heating in cables depends on the current.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: A 2000 W kettle is switched on for 90 s. How much energy is transferred, in J?
questions.hint: Use E = P × t.

questions.subject: phys
questions.q: Explain how a simple a.c. generator produces an alternating voltage.
questions.hint: Describe a coil rotating in a magnetic field, the changing field it cuts and why the direction reverses.
